description: Comprehensive spatiotemporal dataset of shared bicycle operations in Xiamen China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jianrong Cai et al. We present a spatiotemporal dataset of shared bicycle operations in Xiamen, China, collected over five consecutive weekdays (December 21-25, 2020) during morning peak hours (6:00-10:00 AM). Coverage: national (CN); published in 2026. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
